rights: Generated for VECTOR//NOVA with built-in imagegen. Reference artwork was also generated for this project; no third-party reference artwork supplied.
usage: Transparent cup trophy icons for future menu integration. Founders, Frontier and Horizon use green, gold and red accents inspired by the existing menu difficulty colors; Apex uses legendary purple. These are cup tiers, not changes to individual track difficulty.

reference.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single transparent game UI championship icon for the Apex Cup in VECTOR//NOVA, an original futuristic anti-gravity racing game.
Primary request: design a premium, distinctive Apex Cup trophy emblem. A bold faceted silver summit rises from a shallow angular trophy bowl, with two swept racing fins framing the peak and a short integrated pedestal. It should convey the highest-tier championship, speed and mastery.
Style: polished sculptural game icon, precise manufactured geometry, restrained shallow 3D depth, nearly front-on orthographic view. Strong elegant silhouette; a few large shapes and clean negative spaces that remain readable at 64 pixels.
Materials and palette: satin platinum and machined titanium, charcoal recessed surfaces, one confident vermilion-red enamel inset. Broad controlled highlights and crisp bevels, no busy surface detailing.
Composition: one centered isolated emblem on a square transparent canvas, occupying approximately 80 percent of its height, fully visible with generous clear margins. Self-contained lighting with a bright silver edge so it reads against the game's dark charcoal menu.
Constraints: genuine transparent background including openings; no text, letters, numbers, caption, watermark, background scene, square tile, floor, cast ground shadow, particles, lens flares, heavy glow, weapons, skulls or copied existing game logos. Do not create a contact sheet or a UI screenshot. Deliver one finished icon.

images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single transparent championship TROPHY ICON for VECTOR//NOVA, an original futuristic racing game.
The supplied image is a STYLE REFERENCE for this trophy family: match its satin platinum, machined titanium, charcoal recesses, clean enamel inlays, crisp bevel highlights and sculptural near-front orthographic presentation. This requested icon must have its own recognizable trophy silhouette.
A square transparent canvas, one centered upright trophy, fully visible, filling approximately 85% of the height with even margins. A small integrated pedestal. Strong silhouette readable at 64 pixels, deliberate large shapes and clean negative spaces. Consistent neutral studio lighting and metallic craftsmanship.
This is a standalone CUP ICON, not a full button background and not a wide winged emblem. No text, lettering, numbers, watermark, scenery, tile, ground plane, cast ground shadow, particles, excessive bloom or contact sheet. Genuine transparency around the trophy and inside openings. All uncolored metal remains neutral silver and graphite.
Design the FOUNDERS CUP, the first and most approachable tier. A compact, elegant open geometric bowl with two short smoothly swept side handles, a simple central green enamel chevron and a sturdy small pedestal. Broad clean surfaces, restrained detailing, approachable proportions. A clearly recognizable cup shape. Less elaborate and less sharp than the reference: no tall summit, no multiple spear points, no aggressive crown.
Accent palette: the main menu's easy-tier green, base hue #85BE99, expressed as rich jade-green enamel with soft pale-green highlights. Green accents only; remove every red accent from the style reference.
